card.name: Verbs leading into surgery or procedures
card.fires_on: Verbs like requiring or underwent right after a condition, where the next word is a surgical procedure or surgery. Also words inside procedure descriptions such as percutaneous endoscopic gastrostomy.

modes.label: Requiring surgery
modes.description: The word requiring after a disease or complication, followed by surgery or hospitalization.
modes.example: A 2- to 4-fold increase in the risk of gallbladder disease<< requiring>> surgery in postmenopausal women receiving

modes.label: Underwent a procedure
modes.description: A verb that introduces an operation a patient received.

modes.label: Procedure description
modes.description: Words in descriptions of how a tube or scope is placed.
modes.example: Administer DUOPA into the jejunum through a percut<<aneous>> endoscopic gastrostomy with jejunal
